entries.name: cheer
entries.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: replacement 8-frame dance for Sona, a cute illustrated desktop music mascot.
Input image is the CHARACTER DESIGN reference. Preserve exactly the lavender bob, top tuft, violet eyes, dark plum jacket and skirt with mint trim, leggings, shoes, and TWO headphone earcups. Keep the same soft painted sprite style, proportions and colors, not a new character. Headset has a near star earcup on VIEWER RIGHT and narrow plain dark padded earcup on VIEWER LEFT, connected by the headband. Both earcups clearly visible and attached in all eight frames; never switch sides or vanish.
New animation: a sweet small alternating CHEER dance, not an arm circle. Both feet stay grounded below hips with a tiny knee bounce. Forward-facing steady head, happy small smile, BOTH EYES OPEN in all eight poses. Arms never cross and never touch the face or headset.
Create exactly eight complete full-body poses in a 4-COLUMN by 2-ROW grid, left-to-right top row then bottom row. Transparent background, no text, shadows, dividers or extra objects. Identical scale and camera in all cells, generous transparent padding, neutral height 70% of each square cell, feet at 86% cell height.
Pose1: both soft fists resting beside the waist, elbows gently bent, neutral knees.
Pose2: HER RIGHT fist (viewer left) rises to shoulder level out to the side; elbow flexes naturally, other hand remains at waist. Tiny knee dip.
Pose3: same right fist makes a gentle upward diagonal cheer just above ear height and well OUTSIDE head silhouette, elbow still softly bent; other hand at waist. Knees extend gently, no jump.
Pose4: right fist follows same path down to shoulder level, other hand at waist.
Pose5: both fists at waist, same as frame1, centered and relaxed.
Pose6: HER LEFT fist (viewer right) rises to shoulder level out to the side, other hand remains at waist, tiny knee dip.
Pose7: left fist extends gently diagonally above ear height OUTSIDE head silhouette, other hand at waist, knees extend gently, no jump.
Pose8: left fist lowers along same path to shoulder level, ready to settle to pose1.
Hands are cute simple fists, always exactly two arms and two hands. Preserve arm lengths and jacket sleeves. No rotating hands around face, no elbow reversal or flailing, no crossed limbs, no rapid head tilts. Hair and skirt move only subtly. All poses must clearly describe a single coherent motion and loop naturally 8→1. Same anatomical scale throughout.
